sn35.235:1.4: In such contexts, _nimitta_ and _anubyañjana_ are almost always treated as parallel synonyms. The separation of the two, with the instrumental _anubyañjanaso_, is found only at [mn124:20-25.1]() and other late texts.
sn35.235:6.2: A schism in the Saṅgha is regarded as a heinous crime resulting in lower rebirth. It is a legal term in the Vinaya, which requires that a group of monastics who are maliciously promulgating what is against the Dhamma and Vinaya, carry out an _uposatha_ procedure aiming to divide the Saṅgha.
